title: Django Documentation
summary: The official Django docs: models, views, templates, forms, admin, and deployment.
description: Django's documentation is a complete path from the tutorial to production concerns such as authentication, caching, migrations, and security. The stable version tracks the current supported release.

title: Flask Documentation
summary: The official Flask guide to routing, templates, blueprints, and application structure.
description: A compact but thorough reference for building small services and APIs with Flask. The quickstart, patterns, and deployment sections cover the decisions most projects face early.

title: FastAPI Documentation
summary: A fast path from typed request models to production-ready async APIs.
description: FastAPI's docs combine a tutorial, advanced guides, and generated OpenAPI examples. It is especially useful if you want type-driven validation, dependency injection, and automatic interactive docs.

title: Pydantic Documentation
summary: Data validation and settings management built on Python type hints.
description: Pydantic's documentation covers models, validators, serialization, settings, and performance. It is the validation layer behind FastAPI and a useful standalone tool for parsing untrusted data.

title: SQLAlchemy Documentation
summary: The reference for SQLAlchemy Core, ORM models, sessions, and database migrations.
description: A deep, example-rich guide to Python's most established SQL toolkit. Start with the unified tutorial, then use the ORM and Core sections as a reference for real schemas and queries.

title: Full Stack Python
summary: A map of the Python web stack, from WSGI and frameworks to deployment.
description: Full Stack Python explains how the pieces of a Python web application fit together, with concise chapters on frameworks, databases, APIs, static assets, and hosting. Useful for filling conceptual gaps.
